## Parked, no action planned

- Code tidy-up only: the "scroll position" is kept as two numbers instead of one.
  - The app remembers where you scrolled to as: source line at the top of the screen, plus how many rows of that line are hidden above the top.
  - Those two numbers always travel together; a `Caret` type already exists for exactly that pair.
  - So the tidy-up is: store one `Caret` instead of two loose numbers.
  - Nothing is saved to disk, nothing you can see changes, comments are not involved.
  - If this still reads as noise, ignore it; it's a code-shape nit, not a feature or a bug.
